title: Spotube theme payload, v4
description: The full v3 payload: everything a theme may decide about the app's appearance, its components, its shell and the content it puts in them. A v2 host ignores the v3 blocks and draws the two colour schemes, which is what lets a v3 theme ship to an older app.

uiBinding.description: A host-supplied value. item.* and the page scopes are open-ended and resolve only where the host publishes them.

uiFilter.description: A host-side row filter. Matching folds case and Latin diacritics.
